util.js:43 importRecipes is unused dead code, and it is buggy if wired in. It does not trim, skip blank lines or handle \r. It does not validate names or NaN minutes, and a quoted comma splits the name. Importing "Soup,20\r\n\nCake,abc" gives {name:"Soup",minutes:20}, then {name:"",minutes:NaN}, then {name:"Cake",minutes:NaN}. Empty-name and NaN records are accepted. totalMinutes becomes NaN and the blank-name entries are saved, and loadRecipes accepts them because the name is still a string.
